rules.name: Character Backgrounds
rules.text:
Your character’s background is a collection of characteristics that represent the place and occupation that were most formative before your character embarked on a life of adventure.

A background includes the following parts.

rules.name: Ability Scores
rules.text: A background lists three of your character’s ability scores. Increase one by 2 and another one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

effects.label: Increase one listed score by 2 and another by 1, or all three by 1 (none above 20)

source.section: Character Origins > Character Backgrounds > Parts of a Background > Ability Scores

rules.name: Feat
rules.text: A background gives your character a specified Origin feat (described in “Feats”).

source.section: Character Origins > Character Backgrounds > Parts of a Background > Feat

rules.name: Skill Proficiencies
rules.text: A background gives your character proficiency in two specified skills.

source.section: Character Origins > Character Backgrounds > Parts of a Background > Skill Proficiencies

rules.name: Tool Proficiency
rules.text: Each background gives a character proficiency with one tool—either a specific tool or one chosen from the Artisan’s Tools category. Tools are detailed in “Equipment.”

source.section: Character Origins > Character Backgrounds > Parts of a Background > Tool Proficiency

rules.name: Equipment
rules.text: Each background offers a choice between a package of equipment and 50 GP.

source.section: Character Origins > Character Backgrounds > Parts of a Background > Equipment

ambiguities.question: Parts of a Background says the tool is “either a specific tool or one chosen from the Artisan’s Tools category”, but the Soldier gives a choice of Gaming Set, which is neither. Which governs?

readings.text: The Soldier’s own entry governs: choose one kind of Gaming Set. The general rule describes the usual case.
The general rule governs and the Soldier’s choice is an error; no such reading is printed anywhere.

source.section: Character Origins > Character Backgrounds > Parts of a Background > Tool Proficiency

ruling.note: The Soldier's own entry governs: a Gaming Set.

ambiguities.question: The Acolyte’s package A lists “Holy Symbol” without a form; the Holy Symbol entry (p.97) offers Amulet, Emblem or Reliquary, each 5 GP. Which does the Acolyte get?

readings.text: The player chooses one form of Holy Symbol.
The form is left to the table; the sheet records a Holy Symbol with no form.

source.section: Character Origins > Character Backgrounds > Background Descriptions > Acolyte

ruling.note: The player chooses the Holy Symbol form.
